belief_statement: Preliminary evidence indicates that chroma hue value has inconsistent effects on natural perception spatial. The evidence base (2 findings, 1 studies) is growing but not yet conclusive.

mechanisms.pathway: chroma hue value → [unknown mechanism] → natural perception spatial

latent_variables.name: Dose and duration
latent_variables.rationale: Most studies measure presence/absence of chroma hue value, not dose-response curves. Duration and intensity likely matter.
latent_variables.suggested_measure: Parametric variation of intensity and exposure duration

research_needs.question: Does the effect of chroma hue value on natural perception spatial replicate in a pre-registered RCT?
research_needs.rationale: Current confidence is moderate. A well-powered pre-registered replication would most efficiently resolve the status of this belief.

research_needs.question: What is the dose-response curve for chroma hue value effects on natural perception spatial?
research_needs.rationale: Dose-response data enables design guidelines with specific thresholds.
